The MCP registration Claude Code installs.
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is substituted by the harness, so this file carries NO
absolute path from anyone's machine. That is S9.6: a config synced between
nodes once put a Windows interpreter path into a Linux config, and it only
surfaced on restart.
SUTRA_MCP_EXPOSURE is the CEILING, and it is the only thing here a user
should think hard about. It is read by the server AT STARTUP and can never
be changed by a tool call — that is invariant 2, and it is why registering
at `public` is a decision you make once rather than one the model can
renegotiate.
public   the assistant sees only notes you marked public. The default,
and the right choice for any harness that relays to a cloud model.
private  it also sees your private notes. Only if you accept that a cloud
provider processes them.
secret   everything except do_not_learn. Only defensible when the model
runs entirely on this machine.
SUTRA_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE is absent by default, and the server fails closed
without it. Add it only if you want the assistant able to save things into
your inbox — captures are floored to `private` and can never be public.
